title: Happy Code
statement: A game turns a number into the sum of the squares of its digits, again and again. A number is happy if this eventually reaches 1. Return true if n is happy.

answerKey.pattern: Detect a cycle in the sequence: a set of seen numbers, or fast and slow pointers
keyPoints: The sequence either reaches 1 or repeats a number forever
Store seen numbers in a set, or move a slow and a fast pointer
Stop when you reach 1 or meet a repeat
answerKey.timeComplexity: O(log n) per step, few steps
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Run a fixed large number of steps: works but not a real stopping rule

hints: Write out the sequence for 2. Does it ever stop?
If it does not reach 1, it must repeat: the numbers stay small.
Detect the repeat with a set, or with a slow pointer (one step) and a fast pointer (two steps).
